protocol_boundary: User-authorized new protocol after installation/attestation of heatsink, continuous active fan, and open case top; not a retry or extension of pre-V2 rounds.

frequency_invariant.telemetry: per-window scaling_cur_freq at start and end on every online CPU

batch_semantics: All n_records for a decision window are transformed together and passed to the resident portable NumPy action as one batch. Model load/switch cost is excluded here and measured separately.

background_conditions.description: one logical CPU at 50 percent duty
one logical CPU at 100 percent duty

split_order_rule: Run new V2 fit, then new V2 margin, fit predictors and freeze margins, then run new V2 coverage. Never inspect coverage to tune predictors or margins.
condition_order: seeded random permutation independently within each split
row_schedule: seeded permutation of the 6000 frozen scheduler_train rows, cycling only after exhaustion
latency_predictor: Per-action, per-workload, per-background empirical V2 fit-split Q0.99 lookup under the performance governor and validated frequency invariant
thermal_predictor: Ordinary least squares on V2 fit split using the separately frozen V2 predictor configuration
fixed_buffer_rationale: Frozen before V2 data. Retains the conservative buffers preregistered after the historical adverse calibration evidence; V2 coverage cannot change them.
coverage_rule: Report marginal, joint, by-action, and by-cell empirical coverage only; do not tune on coverage
invalid_if: any current undervoltage or throttle low-nibble bit is observed
any recorded CPU frequency is below 1350 MHz
frozen cooling configuration changes or continuous fan operation is interrupted
